selfKeepUpOrder: 1. Odin's Other Eye 273379 (Int/Psy + 4 nanoskills; base attributes -> enables the rest).

2. Six single-school Mocham's Gift 29299/29300/29301/29302/29303/29304 (+140 each) OR one Composite Mochams 220337/220339/220341/220343 (never the SenseImp single together with Composite -- both nanoline 165).
3. Mocham's Neural Interface-Web 95409 (nano-cost reduction, enables chain casting).
5. Improved Anticipation of Retaliation 302188 (evades) when solo/PvP.
Construct Empowerments (275020/263298/260771), Quantum Wings 120499, Soul Fetter/Awaken 233847/233849 are situational, not keep-up.
nanolineStackingTraps: Odin's Other Eye 273379, Odin's Missing Eye 29309, Neuronal Stimulator 220345 all share nanoline 576 -> only the best one applies.

Composite Mochams (220337/220339/220341/220343) sit in nanoline 165 (SenseImp) -> conflict with Mocham's Gift: SenseImp 29304 and with the SenseImp Mastery/Infuse/Teachings. Choose one occupant of line 165.
Within each nanoskill nanoline the tiers (Teachings<Mastery<Infuse<Mocham) do not stack -- only the highest applies.
twinkPriorityForMP: Trader Wrangle (all nano+weapon skills) is the single biggest enabler for equipping higher symbiants/implants and casting above ceiling.
Its OWN stacked nanoskill buffs (six Mocham's Gift + Odin's) count toward symbiant/nano nanoskill requirements.
Attribute buffs for gear reqs: Enforcer Essence (Str/Sta), Doctor Iron Circle (Str/Sta), Agent Feline Grace (Agi)/Enhanced Senses (Sense), Composite Attribute Boost (+12 all).
NanoProgramming for self-building/equipping: Advanced Symbol Manipulation + False Profession family + Trader trade-skill wrangle.
